_doc: THE CATALOGUE OF RESPONSE TYPES for the strikes section (PLAN.md 1.9 · 17.1 c; RUNNING_LOG §297, 2026-10-09) — HIS data from the moment he changes a number; every number the AI's start. A strike window brick (electronics/score/le_strike.js) reads this file at the page's load and sends the numbers its type and timing use IN ITS MESSAGE (dials), so the engine (electronics/sc/strike.scd) needs no file; the engine's own defaults mirror this file as written here. A range is drawn ONCE per window from the window's seed — the same draw in the page's preview and in the engine. After a change: F5 (the page reads it at load); a built score: the builder --replace, then File ▾ → Reload.
_gapMs: the silence after the strike's last onset that says it is over; the answer is placed from the last onset. The window's end + gapMs ends it at the latest.
_level: mimic — each answer onset at the level of the strike onset it came from (the ladder's marks) · or a mark (ppp … fff) — every onset at it
_deal: robin — the players in turn over the answer's onsets, a sample an onset (a strike of six onsets: one player twice) · all — every player at every onset, a chord each

samples._processed: the processed versions of the impulses are rolled beside the raw captures; a player's deck is shuffled when empty, none twice until all are used

asPlayed._doc: the strike's rhythm as it was

retrograde._doc: the rhythm reversed — the levels travel with their onsets

invert._doc: the gaps mirrored: each gap becomes (longest + shortest) − itself, long ↔ short; the onsets keep their order and levels

spread._doc: every gap × one draw in range

compress._doc: every gap × one draw in range

scramble._doc: the gaps shuffled by the window's seed; the levels stay in the onsets' order

rotate._doc: the gaps rotated by a draw of 1 … n−1

thin._doc: a share of the onsets dropped (drawn in share), never the first

thicken._doc: a share of the onsets doubled, each copy copyMs after its original, at its level

rightAfter._doc: the answer's first onset this many seconds after the strike's last onset

callResponse._doc: after the strike's own length × a draw in ofStrike — a strike of one onset counts as minMs long

inLaterWindow._doc: 17.3's: at the start of a later window + a draw in offsetS; with no later window known (the rig) it reads rangeS as muchLater does
